scope: First four-column non-regression comparison encoding attempt
summary: The first comparison encode failed because the 320x185 video tiles plus a 76-pixel header produced an odd 261-pixel H.264 yuv420p frame height.
evidence: libx264 rejected the 1280x261 stream with 'height not divisible by 2'.
The immutable failed output is a zero-byte MP4 under outputs/flower-repair-policy/20260810T205055Z-e65420b0/demo-nonregression-v2.
Training, held-action metrics, and source candidate videos were not modified by the failed presentation encode.
lessons: Presentation builders using yuv420p must validate both composed dimensions as even before starting the encoder.
limitations: This attempt produced no playable demo artifact.
next_actions: Round the derived tile height up to the next even integer and rerun in a new output directory.
